intro: San Marino became the smallest country to win an Olympic medal when it won three at the Tokyo Games in 2021.

chapters.title: Olympic medals
text: At the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, held in 2021, shooter Alessandra Perilli and wrestler Myles Amine won San Marino's first medals.

chapters.title: Football
text: San Marino's football team is one of the weakest in the world; its first ever win came in 2004.

keyTerms.meaning: A gold, silver or bronze medal won at the Olympics.
